text:
zara: Starting a short thread for the docs changelog + relnotes. Targets: migration guide v0.9->v1.0, unify streaming SDK snippets, and a Known Issues blurb about embed streaming fallback. Need quick checks by Thursday EOD.
jay: I can take the snippets. Saw a Python example still using old client.call(). Which PR is that?
zara: PR #4801 (snippets/streaming-update). I left a TODO where python uses client.call().
miguel: I'll update curl examples to the /v1/streams endpoint and add a jq snippet to parse token lines.
elaine: Ran anchor-check quickly: migration.md missing #private-deploy anchor (2 refs); snippets/streaming.md example-id mismatch. Command: `./scripts/anchor-check --report=anchors.txt`
docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck triggered on PR #4801. Status: failed (2 broken anchors).
sam: I can add frontmatter redirects mapping the old rollout anchors to #private-deploy. Small patch.
jay: For snippets, propose standardizing on `client.generate_stream()` across examples and add compatibility note for older SDKs exposing `client.stream.*`. I'll push a draft.
zara: Good. Also drafting the Known Issues line: "If embed streaming falls back to polling during capacity constraints, tokens may be delayed up to ~2s; the system will retry streaming automatically when capacity returns." Keep it user-facing.
miguel: I'll also update migration guide paragraph about batching defaults and add a short cost note: "Server-side batching may reduce per-token cost in high-throughput cases."
elaine: Once sam's redirect patch is up I'll re-run anchor-check and re-trigger CI.
sam: Redirects pushed in a tiny PR.
docs-bot: PR status: #4801 failing links; snippets-unify PR lint OK, snippet-tests pending.
jay: I'll run snippet-tests locally and fix any formatting/running mismatches. If tests fail due to API rename, we'll call that out in the relnotes as a compatibility note.
zara: Timeline: edits done by Thursday EOD, final review Friday morning, publish Friday noon PT. Ping this thread when PRs are green. :tada:
